summary: Nifty broke 23,000 four times in a week, Reliance hit 52-week low, tax relief for FIIs on GSEC interest failed to boost sentiment, 350-point gap-down expected

events.claim: Nifty broke 23,000 support four times in one week
Government announced tax relief on interest income for FIIs in GSEC

lessons: A support broken repeatedly becomes weaker and eventually breaks

summary: Markets consolidated 23,000-23,500 then rallied 1,000 points on Iran ceasefire news, VIX falling for third consecutive session, Nifty near 24,000

events.claim: Nifty rallied ~1,000 points from 23,000 to 24,000 in one week
Brent crude broke below $80 for first time in months
Iran ceasefire news triggered rally on April 8

lessons: The longer the consolidation, the more powerful the next leg
VIX band: 10-12 is lower end, 16-20 is upper end of range
